notes: The synthetic interop fixtures in one file — auto-layout, typography, fills/effects, shapes, constraints, card grid. Each is built to isolate one Figma feature, so a defect here names itself.
The corpus's highest REST diff after `typography` (6.19%), and text-dominated — the case most likely to separate a layout defect from glyph noise.
Data-dense dashboard: nested instances, tables and charts.

Figma's own `Save local copy` of the same file the REST corpus imports, so the .fig path is measured against Figma's render rather than only smoke-tested. Web-exported: `Save local copy` is in the browser's File menu, not desktop-only.
Untitled UI pricing page, component-heavy: 182 nodes across nested instances. Same file as the REST `community-untitled-ui-pricing` case.
46MB, image-heavy. The .fig container CARRIES image bytes where a clipboard paste carries only hashes, so this is the one path that can measure photo fills end to end.
35MB real Figma file, under the 50MB decoder cap. Decode + render smoke coverage for the .fig walker.
127MB. Expected to be refused by MAX_FIG_FILE_BYTES — the cap is a product limit, and this case pins that it is refused loudly rather than truncated.
